reviews.text: Excellent groom on my daughters dog highly recommend

It was my 3-year-old labradoodle’s first time at the groomers, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Andrea was amazing — she took the time to suggest what would be best for my dog’s coat, which isn’t the easiest to work with. She did a fantastic job, and Winnie seemed to really enjoy her visit. Thank you so much, we’ll definitely be back!
2nd time using Bow Wow Beauty and I'm not disappointed! Amazing customer service and very flexible with appointments. Thank you so much again.

Andrea is a gem 💎 extremely helpful, great communication and advice. Sorted my Bertie out and made him look 100% better, gone from long hair (parts of it matted) to a lovely short smooth coat. Made me feel at ease knowing Bertie had never been to a groomers previously. I left him a happy boy and picked him up a happy boy. I would recommend Andrea and will now be seeing Bertie on a regular basis ❤️🐩🦴🐾
Great groomers! Really good with my dogs (lurcher and greyhound) - gets their teeth super clean and trims their nails perfectly. Definitely recommend!

I had an emergency with my cat she got her self in a sticky situation I rang bow wow beauty and told the very nice lady what had happened to my cat and the lady told me to come in even though she was fully booked and Dosnt deal with cats  she helped my cat thank you so much your a life saver xx
Did an amazing job with our dog xx
Our go to dog groomer! Andrea has always done a great job with all our puppers from Bath & Brush to teeth cleaning and nail clipping. Offers a great range of services at a really good price.
Miles always looks great following his haircut at Bow Wow Beauty. Always feel comfortable leaving him with Angela knowing he will be well looked after
